title: Generator pullback map equivariant on adjunction-unit sections
statement: For a scheme morphism f:Y→X [def-pc-scheme] and an invertible X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module] whose tensor pullback f*L [def-pc-module-pullback] is invertible, write T_L and T_f*L for the etale generator torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor], b(W)=W×_X Y, η_T for the set inverse-image unit [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], η_G for the abelian inverse-image unit [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and c_f for the map from f^-1 Gm_X to Gm_Y adjoint to pullback of units. There is a sheaf morphism ρ:f^-1 T_L→T_f*L such that for every etale W→X, g in Gm_X(W), and generator s in T_L(W), ρ(η_T(g s))=c_f(η_G(g)) ρ(η_T(s)), evaluated on b(W). This asserts equivariance only on unit images, without a transported torsor or an assertion about arbitrary inverse-image sections.

proof.text: Build τ from the explicitly constructed etaleGeneratorsPullbackSection. Its naturality field is etaleGeneratorsPullbackSection_naturality (with symmetry for the presheaf naturality convention).
Transpose τ under the set inverse-image adjunction. Its homEquiv inverse equation gives the unit evaluation formula heval for the resulting ρ.
Rewrite both evaluations using heval and apply etale_generators_pullback_map_unit_formula, proved by pullback_map_smulHom and the Gm adjunction unit equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_generators_pullback_unit_map
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} L]
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} ((tensorPullback f).obj L)] :
    let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f
    let η := (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b
      (Type (u + 1)) (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf
    let ηG := (Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).unit.app
      X.gmSheaf
    ∃ ρ : (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf ⟶
        (etaleIsoTorsor ((tensorPullback f).obj L)).sheaf,
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : X.gmSheaf.obj.obj (op W))
        (s : (etaleIsoTorsor L).sheaf.obj.obj (op W)),
        ρ.hom.app (op (b.obj W))
            (η.hom.app (op W) ((etaleIsoTorsor L).vadd (op W) g s)) =
          (etaleIsoTorsor ((tensorPullback f).obj L)).vadd (op (b.obj W))
            ((upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf f).hom.app (op (b.obj W))
              (ηG.hom.app (op W) g))
            (ρ.hom.app (op (b.obj W)) (η.hom.app (op W) s))
